282159386.description:
You are purchasing a "Polished Singular Stone Slice Mineral Bookend Preowned" in "Used" condition.
Striking polished stone slice with a flat base that stands beautifully on its own, perfect as a display piece, paperweight, or unique home decor accent. One side features a rough, natural outer surface, while the cut and polished faces reveal dramatic internal crystal structure with subtle banding and color variation. This piece has an organic, earthy look with a translucent interior that catches the light and highlights the natural patterns. It works well on a desk, shelf, or in a mineral and crystal collection, adding texture and visual interest to any space. Approximate visible size reference is shown with a tape measure in the photos to help you gauge height and width. Keywords: stone slice, crystal display, polished stone, home decor, mineral specimen, standing stone, natural rock, crystal decor, paperweight
